# Buchao Zhan

I am a researcher working at the intersection of **artificial intelligence, knowledge graphs, large language models, and computational biomedicine**.

My research interests include **knowledge representation and reasoning, graph-based machine learning, large language models, biomedical AI, and computational biology**. I have authored and co-authored more than ten papers in international conferences and journals, with work spanning medical question answering, knowledge graph reasoning, semantic parsing, microbiome-based cancer detection, gene prioritization, and single-cell perturbation modeling.

My broader research goal is to develop computational methods that combine **structured biological knowledge, machine learning, and foundation models** to solve challenging problems in biology and medicine.
